name: Higuchi Takafumi
source:
Higuchi used to be Kurosaki's classmate in junior high school. He runs a flower shop that he inherited from his father, but ended up losing the land rights and now faces his shop being cleared out, unless he can buy back the rights from the landowner.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/oreshita/oreshita.php]Boys' Love Game Headquarters[/url]]
